queries.name: operational-value-plot-series
queries.subject: One primary outcome plot per repository, optional campaign, workflow and native measure.
queries.objective: Keep every finite value visible and move provenance to individual observations.
queries.acceptance: Separate unlike units and directions. Preserve evaluator, maturity and cadence on points. Connect only adjacent points with known matching context and declared cadence; never infer a combined trend or baseline.

args.value: Recorded measurements, not a combined trend or a verified impact assessment.

queries.name: operational-value-period-observations
queries.subject: Exact native measurement periods and frozen evaluator identities.
queries.objective: Keep measurement duration, cadence, analysis endpoint and adoption context separate.
queries.acceptance: Use only declared period boundaries and coverage. Never infer legacy metadata or turn the display horizon into an evidence window.

queries.name: operational-value-period-latest
queries.subject: Latest assessment of each exact measurement period.
queries.objective: Do not resurrect an older accepted value when the same period has a newer unavailable assessment.
queries.acceptance: Deduplicate before checking coverage or maturity. Preserve null values and missing metadata.

queries.name: operational-value-complete-period-candidates
queries.subject: Complete mature reference periods.
queries.objective: Require accepted evidence for a recent comparison rather than arbitrary older observations.
queries.acceptance: Only explicitly complete mature periods can serve as references. Missing periods remain missing.

queries.name: operational-value-complete-periods
queries.subject: Complete reference evidence available by the analysis endpoint.
queries.objective: Prevent future reference corrections from changing a historical comparison.
queries.acceptance: A future latest assessment withholds the reference; never resurrect an older accepted correction.

queries.name: operational-value-comparable-history
queries.subject: Native change between adjacent equal-duration measurement periods.
queries.objective: Compare non-overlapping intervals or snapshot cutoffs under one evaluator, independently of adoption classification.
queries.acceptance: The reference ends exactly at the current start, with the same duration, cadence, native unit, direction and evaluator. No overlapping daily rolling comparison or substitution across a gap.

queries.name: operational-value-movements
queries.subject: Direction-aware movement of retained primary repository measures.
queries.objective: Classify native changes without averaging unlike measures.
queries.acceptance: Movement requires current complete mature periods, a known evaluator, native unit, increase/decrease direction and an adjacent equal-duration reference. Expose cohort and exposure changes; no sustained-trend, statistical or causal claim.

args.value: Aggregate movement is not proof of within-cohort improvement.
Eligible cohort changed or its identity was not retained; inspect workload mix.
Cutoff-state change, not a count of remediations.

queries.name: operational-value-ordered-history
queries.subject: Latest observation of each repository measure, before maturity or value filtering.
queries.objective: Prevent an older positive or mature result from masking a newer incomplete observation.
queries.acceptance: Order by measurement cutoff, then assessment timestamp and stable ID. Historical corrections cannot replace a newer measurement period. Missing period metadata falls back to assessment time and remains incomparable. Preserve native zero and null.

queries.name: operational-value-latest
queries.subject: Latest primary outcome per campaign, repository and measure.
queries.objective: Expose the latest retained movement, including incomplete evidence.
queries.acceptance: Latest selection precedes aggregation. Older mature or positive observations cannot mask newer incomplete evidence.

queries.name: operational-value-repository-evidence-order
queries.subject: Identify oldest and newest latest primary evidence per repository.
queries.objective: Expose date bounds across the latest retained primary measures for a repository.
queries.acceptance: Partition by repository, retaining all input rows. Identify first rows in ascending and descending observation order, with ID tie-breaks. Do not infer freshness or fill gaps.

queries.name: operational-value-repository-counts
queries.subject: Latest primary movement counts per repository across campaigns and standalone workflows.
queries.objective: Summarize comparable and missing primary-measure evidence without combining native values.
queries.acceptance: Group by repository; count goals and improving, worsening and unchanged measures. Preserve oldest/newest retained dates. Incomparable goals remain in the total, not in comparable counts.

queries.name: operational-value-repository-signals
queries.subject: One conservative direction signal per repository across all workflow outcomes.
queries.objective: Rank repository investigations while preserving disagreement and evidence gaps.
queries.acceptance: Any incomparable primary measure makes the repository insufficient; opposing comparable measures are Mixed. Count each repository once.

queries.name: operational-value-repository-subjects
queries.subject: Inventory and measured repositories, independent of campaign membership.
queries.objective: Include standalone workflow outcomes and unmeasured inventory repositories.
queries.acceptance: Deduplicate organization/repository identities. Observations outside campaign inventory remain visible; missing measurements are not zero value.

queries.name: operational-value-repository-coverage
queries.subject: Outcome evidence coverage for each repository.
queries.objective: Expose measurement gaps without requiring campaign registration.
queries.acceptance: One row per repository. Count latest primary goals, not reports. Preserve conservative direction and comparison blockers; no evidence is not zero value.

queries.name: operational-value-overview-totals
queries.subject: Repository measurement availability and latest comparable goal counts.
queries.objective: Explain evidence readiness before repository drill-down.
queries.acceptance: Count repositories once across campaigns and standalone workflows. Goal counts describe latest primary measurements, not impact.

queries.name: operational-value-overview-summary
queries.subject: Compact portfolio measurement readiness summary.
queries.objective: Explain comparison readiness without replacing unavailable movement with zero value.
queries.acceptance: Preserve repository and latest goal totals; distinguish no observations from measurements without comparable movement.

args.value: Inspect repository movement and comparison gaps below.
Measurements are available, but none supports a comparable movement yet. Inspect the reasons below.
No primary measurements are retained. Inspect collection and measurement coverage in Evidence; absence is not zero value.

queries.name: operational-value-measured-repositories
queries.subject: Repositories with retained primary outcome measurements.
queries.objective: Choose a repository directly, including standalone workflow outcomes.
queries.acceptance: One repository card across all campaigns and standalone workflows. Preserve disagreement and missing comparison evidence.

queries.name: operational-value-unmeasured-repositories
queries.subject: Inventory repositories without retained primary measurements.
queries.objective: Inspect evidence gaps without implying absent contracts or zero value.
queries.acceptance: Keep every unmeasured inventory repository; no campaign is required.

queries.name: operational-value-direction-repositories
queries.subject: Comparable outcome direction per repository.
queries.objective: Inspect repository movement without combining native values.
queries.acceptance: One count per fully comparable repository. Opposing goals remain Mixed; absent evidence is not neutral. Links open repository history directly.

queries.name: campaign-baseline-successful-runs
queries.subject: Project successful concluded attempts from the selected-horizon campaign baseline.
queries.objective: Show the successful share of concluded runs without implying verified impact.
queries.acceptance: Counts reconcile to campaign-performance-baseline-totals; missing campaigns do not imply zero runs.

queries.name: campaign-baseline-other-runs
queries.subject: Project non-successful concluded attempts from the selected-horizon campaign baseline.
queries.objective: Show the remaining concluded runs for reliability review.
queries.acceptance: Runs equal concluded-runs minus successful-runs; the category includes every other concluded status, not just failures.

queries.name: campaign-baseline-outcome-distribution
queries.subject: Compare successful and other concluded attempts in the selected horizon.
queries.objective: Spot campaign run reliability that needs inspection.
queries.acceptance: Successful and other counts sum to concluded attempts; neither runtime result nor output production establishes operational value.

queries.name: campaign-audit-summary-plot-inventory
queries.subject: Describe the rendered audit-summary chart using the shared campaign Insights plot contract.
queries.objective: Find campaigns with retained high- or medium-severity audit summaries worth reviewing.
queries.acceptance: Each campaign's bucket count equals its retained audit-event-summary-buckets rows; the count describes displayed groups, not distinct incidents or confirmed harm, and missing buckets are not proof of safety.
queries.description: One plot-inventory row per campaign when its high- and medium-severity audit summary chart has data.

queries.name: campaign-insight-plot-inventory
queries.subject: Inventory every plot rendered on each campaign Insights page through one reusable plot contract.
queries.objective: Choose an available campaign Insights plot to inspect its underlying evidence.
queries.acceptance: Each plot entry is supplied by the audit summary plot inventory for the same campaign; experimental operational-value evidence is excluded, no plot count is treated as outcome quality, and unavailable evidence is not synthesized into a plot.
queries.description: One campaign row per rendered Insights plot, independent of the plot's data source or renderer.

queries.name: campaign-insight-tab-counts
queries.subject: Count the plots declared by the shared campaign Insights plot inventory.
queries.objective: Determine whether a campaign has evidence-backed Insights plots to inspect.
queries.acceptance: For every returned campaign, items equals its rows in campaign-insight-plot-inventory for the same horizon; absent rows do not establish absent value, and plot counts do not measure impact.
queries.description: One campaign row with the number of rendered Insights plots, independent of plot type.

pages.intent: Determine which campaign baseline signal needs evidence-backed investigation.
pages.subject: Retained campaign attempts, baseline comparisons and audit observations.
pages.objective: Choose one baseline change for run-level or audit-level investigation.
pages.acceptance: State the baseline/time windows, counts and comparison basis; retain native results and audit provenance. Successful attempts are not accepted outcomes; partial or missing baselines cannot prove improvement.
pages.title: Campaign
pages.description: Identify the campaign baseline signal that most requires investigation.

views.title: Workflow run results
views.subject: Selected-horizon distribution of successful and other concluded campaign attempts.
views.objective: Inspect workflow execution reliability without confusing successful execution with campaign effectiveness.
views.acceptance: Each slice is a count of retained concluded attempts; the total reconciles to concluded runs, and run success is not verified operational value.
views.description: Source: GitHub Actions status and conclusion collected through gh aw logs for this campaign's control-repository workflows in the selected time window. Each rerun counts as a separate attempt. Other concluded attempts include failures, cancellations, timeouts, skipped runs and other non-success conclusions; queued and running attempts are excluded. This does not measure changes in target repositories.
views.empty-message: No concluded workflow attempts are retained for this campaign in the selected time window.

views.title: Execution reliability
views.description: Measured from retained control-repository workflow attempts collected through gh aw logs, not from target-repository improvements. Success rate = successful attempts / concluded attempts in the selected time window; reruns count separately. Outputs are reported safe-output items from successful attempts, not confirmed merges or resolved problems. Average AIC includes only successful attempts with a recorded positive AI Credit cost. Missing collection history is not reconstructed.
views.empty-message: No campaign run attempts were observed during the selected horizon.

views.title: Audit events
views.description: Audit event summaries with links to dedicated entity insights and related runs.
views.empty-message: No high- or medium-severity audit events were observed for this campaign in the current run window.

pages.intent: Compare the selected repository's operational measurements over time.
pages.subject: Timestamped native operational-value observations for the routed repository.
pages.objective: Assess measurement direction and comparison evidence without inferring causality.
pages.acceptance: Keep metric identity, unit, direction, maturity, observation times and baseline basis explicit; do not combine unlike units or replace missing measurements with zero. Separate observations from verified gains.
pages.title: Operational Value
pages.description: Assess whether the selected repository's operational measurements support a comparison.

config.empty-message: No measurements in this horizon. Try a longer time window.

views.title: Recent period comparison
views.description: Native change uses the immediately preceding complete period, not adoption. Exposure and cohort changes can explain aggregate movement. Unchanged is not a health or target-attainment assessment.
